gloss: total number; all items; complete count

definitions.gloss: total number; all items; complete count
definitions.explanation: The entire quantity or every single item in a group, with no exceptions.

examples.japanese: {全数|ぜんすう}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全数|ぜんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全数|ぜんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to have a grasp of the total inventory count.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{全数|ぜんすう}⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Because defective items were found, all units will be recalled.

notes:
⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (all, complete) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number, count). Emphasizes that every single item is included, not just a sample or subset.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全数|ぜんすう}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: 100% inspection (inspecting every item, not sampling)
- {全数|ぜんすう}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: complete survey, census
- {全数|ぜんすう}⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧: total recall (of products)
- {全数|ぜんすう}⟦{把握|はあく}→把握：05625_haaku⟧: complete count/tracking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{総数|そうすう}→総数：20724_sousuu⟧: total number, grand total — the sum of all items counted; focuses on the resulting number rather than completeness
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: all, everything — everyday word for "all"; less formal and technical
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧: the whole, entirety — refers to the whole as a unit rather than counting individual items

USAGE:
Primarily used in manufacturing, quality control, public health reporting, and statistical contexts. {全数|ぜんすう}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (inspecting every item) is contrasted with {抜|ぬ}き{取|と}り⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (sampling inspection) in quality management.
